question_answered: Given the official structure and the historical counts, what should be studied first?
only_valid_source: Explicit judgement, which must name the official and historical inputs it was derived from
blocked_reason: Both inputs are missing: no official marks structure (B-09) and no counted papers (B-02). A priority ordering produced over no data would be indistinguishable from invention, and it would be the most persuasive kind because it would look like advice.
rules: This is a judgement, labelled as one, and shown to a learner only with its tier visible.
Every entry must list the input record ids it was derived from. A priority with no inputs is deleted, not kept as a hunch.
Never merged into an official-looking figure. A learner must always be able to tell which numbers came from the board and which came from this file.
Revisable without ceremony. When counts change, priorities change; that is expected and is not an error to hide.
